summary: Namco's arcade drift-racing series, spanning System 22 arcade originals, PlayStation launch racers, handheld compilations, HD console entries, and mobile spin-offs.

entries.title: Ridge Racer

emulation.emulator: Official Arcade Archives 2 / original arcade hardware / PlayStation emulation for secondary
emulation.notes: Use the official modern release for the main arcade route; use DuckStation only for the PlayStation secondary extras.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Official modern arcade emulation on PS5/Xbox Series X|S/Switch 2

primary.platform: PlayStation 5 / Xbox Series X|S / Nintendo Switch 2 (Arcade Archives 2)
primary.why: The original game began on Namco System 22 arcade hardware, with PlayStation, mobile, Zeebo, and later Arcade Archives releases. Arcade Archives 2 preserves the arcade version on modern hardware with convenience modes and leaderboards, making it the best main play route; the PlayStation conversion remains a secondary curiosity for its home-port additions.
primary.how_to_play: Play Arcade Archives 2 Ridge Racer on PS5, Xbox Series X|S, or Nintendo Switch 2. Use the PlayStation release separately only to sample its home-version extras.

secondary.exclusive_content: Home conversion features such as the Galaxian loading minigame and PlayStation-specific presentation options
secondary.what_to_play: Sample the PlayStation version for the loading minigame and home-port differences after finishing the arcade route.
secondary.why: The modern arcade release is higher fidelity/authentic to the arcade original, but the PlayStation port has home-version curiosities not present in the arcade build.

entries.remaster_caveats: Arcade Archives 2 preserves the arcade original, not the PlayStation conversion or later compilation-style games.

primary.how_to_play: Play on an original linked arcade setup when available; otherwise preserve through a legal arcade-emulation setup.

entries.remaster_caveats: No modern remaster exists.
